dose_entries.adjudication: OWNER RULING 2026-08-25: ruled for the repeated-bolus shape. owner_declaration.justification: PFC doctrine explicitly prescribes intermittent ketamine push as the no-pump sedation approach for a ventilated patient (JTS ID61 Appendix A Minimum/Better rows, ID80 p.9, ID29 Appendix A) — the SHAPE is sourced.
